sar._doc: Curated SAR facts (binding-mode-aware) to ground generator/judge reasoning. Not measurements; verified from literature + PDB 1M17 / 2ITY / 4HJO.

shared_pharmacophore.hinge_binder: 4-aminoquinazoline N1/C8 forms a BIDENTATE H-bond with Met793 backbone NH/C=O in EGFR ATP pocket. This pair of H-bonds is the dominant potency driver; nearly every active EGFR inhibitor (gefitinib, erlotinib, afatinib, vandetanib, lapatinib) preserves it.
shared_pharmacophore.pocket_layout: Pocket = hinge region (Met793, Cys797) + hydrophobic pocket I (Leu694, Val702, Ala719, Leu820) + solvent-front (C6/C7 of quinazoline).

erlotinib.binding_notes: Western aryl is meta-ethynyl substituted (small, hydrophobic, no halogen); this is unusual among EGFR inhibitors and leaves room for hydrophobic-pocket-I optimization.
suggestions: swap western aryl for 3-Cl-4-F-aniline (gefitinib pattern) to gain hinge + hydrophobic synergy
replace bis-ether tail with morpholinopropoxy for a stronger solubility/Vina balance
try 7-position substitution only (mono-ether) to lower logP by ~1.0
avoid: do NOT add acrylamide/Michael acceptor unless you intend a covalent design (afatinib territory)
do NOT extend the bis-ether beyond OCH2CH2OCH2CH2 — rotatable-bond penalty in ADMET

key_groups: 6-methoxy + 7-(3-morpholinopropoxy) (rigid methoxy at 6 + basic amine tail at 7)
gefitinib.binding_notes: 3-Cl-4-F-aniline is the GOLD-STANDARD western aryl across first/second-gen EGFR TKIs. Morpholinopropoxy tail protonates at physiological pH (pKa ~7.4) and improves aqueous solubility ~100x vs unsubstituted quinazoline.
suggestions: vary the C7 tail: try piperidinylethoxy, pyrrolidinylpropoxy, dimethylaminoethoxy to explore basic-amine SAR
try core-hopping: replace quinazoline with pyrido[3,4-d]pyrimidine (one extra ring N) to gain a 3rd hinge H-bond
avoid: do NOT remove the western aryl 4-amino (loses hinge bidentate H-bond)
do NOT put basic amines at C6 — only at C7 (orientation matters for solvent exposure)

key_groups: alpha,beta-unsaturated amide (acrylamide) Michael acceptor at C6 — covalent warhead to Cys797
afatinib.binding_notes: Covalent inhibitor — forms irreversible Cys797 adduct via Michael addition. Vina (noncovalent) docking UNDER-ESTIMATES potency because it cannot score the covalent bond.
suggestions: use ONLY as a structural reference for the western aryl + C7 tail
do NOT propose new acrylamide warheads unless the project explicitly targets covalent EGFR
for noncovalent designs, replace the acrylamide with -OH, -NH2, or -OMe to recover a Vina-comparable baseline
avoid: MUST NOT benchmark afatinib analogues against noncovalent Vina scores — protocol mismatch (see provenance.note)
MUST NOT include reactive electrophiles (Michael acceptors, alkyl halides, sulfonyl esters) unless covalent design is the explicit goal

provenance.note: Afatinib is a covalent inhibitor; noncovalent docking is not a potency comparison.
